not_rebuilt.reason: scripts/prompt-archaeology/clean-arm-audit.ts reads every file of every trial, and it ran over the full merged tree before harness state, workspaces and raw harness logs were left out of the commit; rerun on the committed files it still finds no hit, but it reads fewer files, so its file counts and skipped lists can't match.

not_rebuilt.what: The preregistration's computed files (prereg.json, lease-plan.json, budget.json, mdd.json, mdd.md and calibration/task-rule.json)
not_rebuilt.reason: build-prereg.ts reads and writes fixed paths inside the committed run folder and has no flag to point it at a copy; its --check mode, run by hand, finds all six current, and only a pinned script hash in PREREGISTRATION.md out of date, because scripts/prompt-archaeology/tables.ts changed after the preregistration (commits e5eff763e7, #236, and 50b1463da2).

not_rebuilt.what: The calibration analysis (calibration/calibration-analysis.json, design-options.json and projection.json, and the design tables in calibration.md)
not_rebuilt.reason: calibration/inputs/analysis.ts and design-options.ts import the repository's scripts by paths that only work from the repository root, and projection.py and design-table.py read absolute paths in the author's work folder, so none of them runs on the committed copy.
